patch_description: This implementation replaces endpoint-regression tracking with a robust adaptive local-linear Kalman filter. It estimates measurement noise from robust trailing first-difference statistics, clips impulsive innovations before state updates, and adaptively increases process noise when coherent motion is detected. A CUSUM-style directional evidence accumulator confirms only sustained counter-trend motion before allowing displayed reversals. This separates state estimation from reversal detection: the Kalman state stays responsive, while the output avoids noise-driven directional chatter.
